meta.guide_edition: 2026 MICHELIN Guide Southwest (inaugural; revealed 2026-08-26 at Fontainebleau Las Vegas; guide had not evaluated Las Vegas since 2009)

official_sources.label: MICHELIN Guide official Las Vegas restaurant list (24 restaurants)
Michelin press release: first-ever Southwest selection (star + address lists)

All distinctions and addresses below verified against the two official sources above on 2026-11-25.
